mentions.name: Nashist
mentions.description: This project digitizes a large inherited collection of Urdu magazines and books, many of which are physically deteriorating with age, so they can be read on modern devices. It is in very early stages.
mentions.problem: The inherited physical Urdu magazines and books are withering away due to old age
mentions.audience: The author personally, to enjoy the digitized collection on modern devices
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on digitizing them so I can enjoy them on modern devices. Very much in initial stages.
mentions.author: microflash
